title: Several Wardmoor moor rooms (e.g. The Elbow, Cliff Edge, The Grey Ford) describe Hollowbrook as visible/close ('low country starts somewhere past the haze', 'toward Hollowbrook's dike country') but expose no actual exit crossing into Hollowbrook from any of them, costing turns hunting for a passage that isn't there.
